name: silverbark
lore_descriptor: pale silver bark, almost luminous; smelling of starlight
first_pickup_chronicle: Silverbark. Galadhrim wood. Bows cut from these trees do not miss in the dark, and the dead recoil from them.
design_notes: F75 peak — wood equivalent of silver+mithril hybrid. Triple-effective (undead/fey/demon_minor) but damage_mult 1.20 (not stacked with the bonuses). Light (weight_mult 0.8) — ideal bow material. Mythologically Lothlórien.
